summary: A Claude seat whose trust-prompt recovery is held back after repeated prompts is re-evaluated when the oldest of those prompts leaves the ten-minute window, so recovery resumes on time instead of at the next full pass

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: The recovery's limits and its attention request are unchanged. A seat left at the dialog changes no screen digest, so nothing marked it when recovery could resume.

recovery.detail: An older build resumes recovery at its next full pass.
